name: 03_panel_upper_headroom
mechanism: A median nearer the panel's p25 than p75 leaves more room for an upward panel-median step. Widen the upper offset where that asymmetry and forecast horizon give a positive activation.
prediction: Practice pooled skill rises 0.001 to 0.005 through up >5% cells at h7, while q50 stays fixed.
evidence_before_edit: Up >5% carries 34.84% of practice baseline loss, and 48.94% of those cells exceed mix q90.
